subtopics: Evidence supporting Marconi's 1901 Signal Hill claim: Kemp and Paget witness testimony, Marconi's notebooks, the 1923 Poldhu-Signal Hill re-enactment using replica 1901 equipment, and the February 1902 SS Philadelphia confirmation experiments

Historians' assessments of the 1901 transatlantic claim: Sungook Hong, W.J. Baker, Marc Raboy, Huw Williams, 2001 centenary debates, IEEE and academic literature on whether Marconi actually heard the signal

Modern technical analyses and replication studies of the December 1901 Poldhu-to-Signal-Hill experiment: Belrose's modeling, centenary simulations, Bondyopadhyay's Bose detector argument, conclusions about feasibility
